title: Baby on Blanket with Plush Toy, Garden Lawn - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot captures an alert infant sitting barefoot on a dark blanket laid across a grass lawn. Positioned beside the baby is a plush stuffed animal toy. The infant is dressed in a dark one-piece playsuit featuring a contrasting white Peter Pan collar and small buttons. Dappled sunlight filters through the leafy trees above, with a wooden fence and trellis visible in the softly focused background, evoking quiet domestic life in the late 1930s.
